Warehouse AGVs — bidding, fetching, charging

Four automated guided vehicles share one warehouse floor. A task is announced, the vehicles bid for it, and the winner fetches the pallet.

What to watch for

The amber aisle is congested — passable, but four times the cost to cross. Watch the blue routes prefer the western cross-aisle instead. That is the grid's cell costs deciding, not the drawing. Colour shows what a vehicle is doing rather than which one it is.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (102 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
